Rooms & Suites
Our rooms, with breathtaking views over Lake Geneva or the gardens, come in four categories. Our guests can choose from unique styles and top-of-the-range facilities, particularly in our three exceptional Suites.

Restaurant
At the 57° Grill, the Chef sublimates meat, fish and shellfish with precise cooking at 57°, right before your eyes. In a relaxed atmosphere, far from strict uniforms, enjoy a convivial culinary experience at the Château d'Ouchy, with friends or family.

Wellness
Treat yourself to a moment of escape at the Boudoir of Château d’Ouchy.
Massages, treatments, and relaxation rituals await you in this haven of well-being, designed to soothe both body and mind. In summer, extend this moment of serenity by enjoying our outdoor pool, nestled among majestic trees – a true oasis of peace.

Castle Bar
In an elegant décor, the Château d'Ouchy bar offers inventive cocktails and refined spirits. You can also sample our Tres Hermanos cigars or enjoy a game of billiards with friends. It's the ideal place to relax and socialise.

Superior Room
Arriving at Château d’Ouchy, you can almost imagine hearing the clip-lopping of hooves and seeing elegant knights astride their horses. Inside, the modernity of the place can be surprising , and you will definitely be relieved to find that the rooms have traded in their medieval roughness for the peace and comfort of a luxury hotel . Pastel colours and warm light create a pleasant atmosphere , while the extraordinarily cosy bedding and the calm atmosphere of Ouchy guarantee the most refreshing sleep you’ve ever had.
Superior Lake-View Room
Sleeping in a lakeside castle with a view of the lake and surrounding mountains surely is everyone’s dream! This is the fairy tale awaiting the guests accommodated in the Superior Lake-View Rooms at Château d’Ouchy. The ever changing but always spectacular view of Lake Geneva has a soothing, almost therapeutic effect.
Deluxe Room
With their comfortable design and spacious layout, the Deluxe Rooms have an immediate restorative effect and are ideal for work, relaxation or couples in love. The ancient exposed stone walls and four-poster bed (available in some deluxe rooms) turn guests into “sleeping beauties” and “prince charmings”.
Deluxe Lake-View Room
Spacious and with a view of Lake Geneva and the Alps : the Deluxe Lake-View Rooms are practically irresistible . It would be tempting to just keep to your room throughout your stay, but as this is a castle, there is always something exciting to do and explore!
Junior Suite
To give you the chance to feel like a real lord of the castle , our ten Junior Suites come in different styles and with a range of characteristic features. If you are looking for a modern, luxurious but refined style, the Junior Suites located in the contemporary part of the castle are an excellent choice. Some of these rooms feature exposed beams – a little nod to history.

Knight’s Suite
The Knight’s Suite is where adventures begin ... or the grandest night of your life. Few hotels can offer their guests the experience of spending time in the sleeping quarters of a true lord, surrounded by gargoyles, historic wood panelling , vibrant stained glass windows, period tapestries and a magnificent high wooden ceiling.
Riviera Suite
The exceptional Riviera Suite will take you on an unforgettable journey back in time. The unique and authentic decoration – typical of the neo-Gothic castles of the 19th century – will immediately immerse you in its historic charm. Aptly named, the Riviera Suite offers an extraordinary 360-degree panoramic view onto the shores of Lake Geneva and the surrounding mountains.
Terrace Suite
This suite is for everyone who wants to feel at home in a historic lakeside castle – individuals, couples or families. The largest private terrace of the hotel allows you to enjoy a unique view of Ouchy harbour.

The castle
A true haven of peace nestled on the shores of Lake Geneva, the Château d'Ouchy is a must for lovers of the beautiful and the exceptional.
Rooms & Suites
Both magical and avant-garde, this jewel box contains 49 rooms with a strong character, including 10 Junior Suites and 3 Suites with the enchanting atmosphere of the dungeon.
The 57 grill
Grilled, spit-roasted or roasted, meat, fish and shellfish lovers, welcome to 57°: the Château d'Ouchy's live-cooking restaurant!
The bar
The bar is a place, a style and a service unique to Lausanne. The bartenders mix delicious cocktails and give advice on local wines, while passing on their best tips on Lausanne.
The terrace
The terrace of the Château d'Ouchy - decked out in teak and greenery - is the place to be for warm evenings at the start of the summer season, giving a nautical feel to afterwork sessions and meals that go on into the night.
The pool
The hotel's outdoor swimming pool allows you to relax and take a dip in a natural setting, surrounded by trees and away from prying eyes.
Wellness
The Spa is an oasis of relaxation with a sauna, steam room and sensory shower. You can also enjoy a massage or a treatment in our "Boudoir".
The vinotheque
In a modern and contemporary setting, the vinotheque is the ideal place for a meal or a simple drink with friends. For professional events with 8 to 15 participants, the wine library becomes an original conference room. The Château d'Ouchy team will go out of its way to organise weddings worthy of a fairy tale.

L'Hotel Angleterre is the deputy hotel of Château d'Ouchy. Located 50 meters from the hotel in a lush green area, it is ideal for organizing residential seminars.
Located in a lush green area at the edge of the city yet so close to the centre, Hotel Angleterre is ideal for organising residential seminars .
The hotel’s five lounges are designed for hosting meetings and seminars of every kind in both a personal and stimulating atmosphere . Every room features air-conditioning and state-of-the-art equipment . With natural light, a very quiet environment and sober furnishings , the rooms encourage productive work and contemplation.
Bright, elegant and warm – the five lounges at the Hotel Angleterre are the perfect setting for decadent cocktail parties and memorable private events.
Each room is air-conditioned and equipped to the highest standard . You can order healthy and tasty Italian meals for your event, lovingly prepared by our chefs at L’Accademia restaurant.
The surrounding lush green garden adds a peaceful and rustic touch, allowing time to pass at a pleasantly relaxed pace.

wikipedia.title: Château d'Ouchy
wikipedia.extract: The Château d'Ouchy is a hotel built on the site of a former medieval castle in the Ouchy lakeside neighbourhood of Lausanne, Switzerland by businessman Jean-Jacques Mercier between 1889 and 1893. It belongs to the hotel division of the Sandoz Family Foundation.
